title: Emote
caption: Moods and words follow the actor's head, even when mirrored
intro: Five moods on the captain, AI colleague and robot: a question, surprise, a sparkle, thinking dots or an empty thought. Speech examples show where words sit beside the head and how they stay readable after a flip.
contract: Character and Robot share mood and says. Import their components from slide-shared/character/character and deep-sea-expedition/robot; actor.ts declares the mood vocabulary. Emote placement belongs to the actor, not the Slide. Keep says in the Slide's Translation files; an emote appears after the actor's motion and stays visible.
pilotSays: Didn't we do this exact dive yesterday?
